name: KpiCard
description: A headline metric in a Card: a Stat's label, value and change, with a sparkline of its trend beside the value and, when there is one, progress toward a target. A period control (a Select) can sit in the label row.

livewire.name: kpi-card
capabilities: The period slot holds a control, such as a Select bound with wire:model.live
2.x title, value, icon, change, changeLabel and sparkline-data still work, mapped onto stat and sparkline

react.name: KpiCard
capabilities: period takes a node, such as a Select

vue.name: KpiCard
capabilities: The period slot holds a control, such as a Select with v-model

props.name: stat
props.description: The metric, with Stat's props: { label, value, unit, icon, color, delta, change, trend, description, upLabel, downLabel, flatLabel }. color tints the icon tile and the target bar, and is emitted as data-color on the root.

props.name: sparkline
props.description: The metric's recent values, drawn as an area Sparkline beside the value. Use one scale for the cards in a row. Omit it and the value takes the row.

props.name: sparklineLabel
props.description: The sparkline's accessible label; {first}, {latest}, {min}, {max} and {count} are filled in. Translate it: Livewire defaults it through __( 'Trend from {first} to {latest}' ).

props.name: target
props.description: Progress toward a goal: { value, max, label }. max defaults to 100; label names the goal ("Goal $25,000") and the bar. Show a target only when one exists.

props.name: targetLabel
props.description: The text at the end of the target row; {percent}, {value} and {max} are filled in. Translate it: Livewire defaults it through __( '{percent}% of goal' ).

props.name: period
props.description: A control for the period, such as a Select, in the label row before the icon.

props.name: classes
props.description: Extra classes per part, such as { value: '…', sparkline: '…' }.

parts.name: root
parts.description: The card: .apui-card.apui-kpi-card, with data-color from stat.

parts.name: top
parts.description: The label row: label, period and icon.

parts.name: icon
parts.description: The tinted icon tile. Hidden from assistive technology.

parts.name: row
parts.description: The summary beside the sparkline, aligned to their bottoms.

parts.name: delta
parts.description: The change: hidden direction text, an arrow and the change, with data-trend.

parts.name: sparkline
parts.description: The trend: a Sparkline (.apui-sparkline, role=img) with a label stating the first and latest values.

parts.name: target
parts.description: Progress toward the goal: a small Progress, then targetText.

parts.name: targetText
parts.description: The goal's label at the start and targetLabel at the end.

slots.name: period
slots.description: The period control, such as a Select.

requirements: The sparkline is role=img with a label that states its first and latest values; the target bar is a labeled progressbar with its percentage as text beside it.
The change follows Stat: visible text with an arrow and a hidden direction label, never color alone.
The icon tile is decorative and hidden from assistive technology.
Muted text keeps 4.5:1 on the card; the sparkline and bar keep 3:1.
